stem: Based on the events at the end of the story, what can the reader predict about Coyote?

options.label: F
options.text: Coyote will not trust Conejo again.

options.label: G
options.text: Coyote will no longer try to swim in the lake.

options.label: H
options.text: Coyote will find a way to get the cheese.

options.label: J
options.text: Coyote will discover Conejo in his burrow.
